description: The portfolio's configuration by name rather than by copy: the timezone, the Monday schedule and the groups that say a release is one pull request all live in `youndie/sborka`, and a repository that pastes them is a repository that stops getting the next fix to them.

The harness preset is extended SECOND on purpose - package rules are concatenated in the order the presets are named, and its rule has to win over the base preset's `a major of anything that ships gets a human`.

Its precondition holds here, and it is not rhetorical: `.github/workflows/check.yaml` runs on `pull_request`, so a green pull request means the gate actually ran. If that trigger is ever narrowed, this line has to go with it.

Nothing razves-specific is added yet. What this repository needs beyond the preset will be found by the preset failing to cover it - the one known gap is that the TestKit tests pin a Kotlin version as a Kotlin constant, where no manager can see it.
